title: Rian Johnson Remains Open to Star Wars Return but Is Writing an Original Project
excerpt:
At the Marrakech Film Festival, The Last Jedi director reaffirmed his affection for Star Wars.
He has not announced a return and says his next script is neither Star Wars nor Knives Out.
body_md:
Rian Johnson has not closed the door on returning to Star Wars. Speaking at the Marrakech Film Festival, the filmmaker behind The Last Jedi described his lasting affection for the franchise, even as he made clear that his immediate creative plans lie elsewhere.

Johnson said he is already writing his next project and that it is neither a Star Wars film nor another Knives Out installment. He also explained that he currently enjoys developing his own material. His remarks should not be mistaken for an announcement of a new Lucasfilm assignment: there is no confirmed title, production schedule, or release date attached to a possible return.

The director reflected on how personally invested he felt while making The Last Jedi. For him, working within a cultural phenomenon does not lessen the importance of an individual creative perspective. Rather, he argued, a filmmaker and crew need to care deeply about their own interpretation of the material if they are to make something meaningful within a universe shared by generations of viewers.

Released in 2017, The Last Jedi became one of the most debated entries in the Star Wars sequel trilogy. Its treatment of legacy characters and its willingness to challenge expectations drew praise from some audiences and intense criticism from others. Those disagreements have continued to shape discussions about Johnson's place in the franchise.

His latest comments also underline an important distinction between audience controversy and a filmmaker's relationship with the fictional world itself. Johnson says his appreciation for Star Wars has grown, and he welcomes the fact that different creative voices are now exploring it. That does not imply that any particular fan theory or proposed setting has entered development.

Some fans would prefer to see him tell a self-contained story away from the Skywalker saga, while others remain skeptical after The Last Jedi. Suggestions that he tackle the Old Republic era are fan proposals rather than studio announcements. For now, the only concrete update is that Johnson is working on a separate script and remains personally receptive to the possibility of revisiting the galaxy far, far away.
seo_title: Rian Johnson Is Still Open to Returning to Star Wars
seo_description: Rian Johnson says he still loves Star Wars but is currently writing a project unrelated to the franchise or Knives Out.
